question: Priya had saved 126 dollars in a jar. Over the weekend she earned 8 dollars for raking leaves, found 3 dollars in an old coat, and received 32 dollars from her grandmother. At the bank she changed the entire jar into quarters, at 4 quarters to the dollar. At the arcade every quarter buys 9 tokens, and she fed all of her quarters into the machine. How many tokens did Priya get?

Marcus started the week with 126 stickers. He gave half of them to his friend Leah. On Wednesday a trading event doubled the number of stickers Marcus had left. On Thursday he received 80 stickers from a new pack, and on Friday he handed 83 of his stickers to Leah, after which Leah had more stickers than Marcus. How many stickers does Marcus have now?

A courier firm bills its clients by the minute. In the morning Dana drove 8 routes of 89 minutes each, and then the dispatcher struck 74 minutes of idling from the log. In the afternoon the second driver logged exactly as many minutes as the whole morning total, so the running total doubled. Before dinner the client disputed 906 minutes, which were removed from the bill. In the evening Dana drove for one more hour, which is 60 minutes, and that time was accepted. How many billable minutes did the firm record for the day?

Coach Ruiz keeps a distance log for the swim club. At the start of the week the log showed 88 laps; the swimmers added 41 laps during the week and 8 more on Saturday. Each lap is 8 lengths of the pool, so the coach converted the whole lap total into lengths. The relay squad, which trains twice a week, then added 27 extra lengths on Sunday. For the league standings every length is worth 9 points, and the club was also awarded 70 bonus points for attendance. How many points does the club have in the standings?

A lemonade stand's tank held 46 gallons at opening, and the owners poured in 70 more gallons before the crowd arrived. They serve by the cup, so they worked out the volume in cups: there are 4 quarts in a gallon, and 4 cups in a quart. During the day they served 706 cups. How many cups of lemonade are left in the tank?

Nina and Theo baked 156 cookies and spread them equally over 4 trays. Nina took one tray for herself, then found 3 more cookies on the counter and added them. Theo gave her 21 cookies from his tray, so Nina now had more cookies than Theo. She sold each of her cookies for 3 dollars at the fair and received a 25 dollar tip. How many dollars did Nina collect?

Kofi has 232 stamps in his album. He gives 55 stamps to his cousin Ama, and even after that Kofi still has more stamps than Ama. The stamp fair, which runs for 4 days, values each of Kofi's stamps at 3 credits. Because of a promotion, the fair then doubles the credits he holds. Kofi spends 543 credits on a rare stamp. How many credits does Kofi have left?

A dairy had 94 pints of cream. It sold 40 pints to a bakery, and 6 pints spoiled and were thrown away. The rest was poured into quart bottles, with 2 pints filling each quart. The quart bottles were then packed into gallon crates, 4 quarts to a gallon. How many gallons of cream does the dairy have?

In the morning the bakery made 5 batches of 231 bread rolls, and there were 39 rolls left over from the day before. In the afternoon a cafe bought 522 rolls, and walk-in customers bought 276 rolls. In the evening the baker cut each remaining roll into 3 pieces for croutons. There were already 51 pieces bagged from earlier. How many crouton pieces does the bakery have?

In the morning Grandpa gave 150 dollars to be split equally among his 5 grandchildren, and Lily took her share straight to the bank, where she changed all of it into quarters at 4 quarters to the dollar. The arcade is 3 blocks from her house. In the afternoon she spent half of her quarters at the arcade. In the evening she found 18 more quarters in her coat pocket. How many quarters does Lily have?

A charity run had 206 registered runners. Then 68 more registered online, 25 signed up at the school, 61 joined through a company team, and 10 registered on the morning of the race. A dozen volunteers handed out water along the 21 kilometre route. The organizers divided all the runners equally into 5 starting waves. How many runners are in the first wave?

In the morning the busker's guitar case held 126 cents. He keeps his tally in cents and never bothers converting it into dollars. A passer-by dropped in 16 cents and a family added 58 cents before noon. In the afternoon he collected 38 cents. In the evening a late listener gave 14 cents. How many cents did the busker have at the end of the day?

In the morning the ship's chandler had 26 fathoms of rope; a fathom is 6 feet, so he measured his stock in feet. In the afternoon a delivery added 67 feet of rope. In the evening he sold all of the rope at 6 dollars per foot and also sold a brass hook for 58 dollars. How many dollars did the chandler take in?

The choir sold 35 concert tickets on the first day, 26 on the second, and 61 on the third. Each ticket cost 9 dollars. A sponsor agreed to triple whatever amount the choir raised from tickets. Afterwards 18 dollars in loose donations were added. The whole sum was then shared equally among 3 charities. How many dollars does the animal shelter charity receive?

In the morning Farah's shop had 63 umbrellas; a delivery of 61 arrived, then a second supplier brought 65 more, and she moved every umbrella onto the front display. In the afternoon 18 umbrellas were sold from the display. In the evening a storm broke and 140 umbrellas were sold. Her rival Gabe, across the street, sold fewer umbrellas than Farah that day. How many umbrellas are left on Farah's front display?

In the morning Hana counted 203 pastries in her cafe, and the bakery delivered 78 more. The cafe has 14 tables. In the afternoon she sold every pastry at 5 dollars each and collected 16 dollars in tips. In the evening she paid the supplier 293 dollars. Her brother Kenji's stall took in less money than Hana's cafe that day. How many dollars does Hana have at the end of the evening?

Bea had 140 marbles. She won 45 in a game and was given 16 by her aunt. She then gave 133 marbles to her brother Carl, after which Carl had more marbles than Bea. Bea entered the remaining marbles in a contest where each marble earns 7 points, and the judge doubled her points for the neatest display. She spent 815 points on a prize. How many points does Bea have left?

Ravi's class account had 88 reward points. He earned 23 points for homework and then spent 108 points on a class party. The class has 28 students. His teacher opened a new term ledger for Ravi, starting it with the points he had left. He then earned 42 ledger points for reading, 74 for a science project, and 67 for helping in the library, while his classmate Sana has fewer ledger points than Ravi. How many points are on Ravi's term ledger?

Yusuf and Elena ran a lemonade stand. Yusuf sold 137 cups on Saturday and 70 cups on Sunday, at 3 dollars a cup, and he was given 25 dollars in tips. Elena's own sales came to less than Yusuf's. Yusuf gave half of his money to Elena for supplies. How many dollars does Yusuf keep?

Ana had 72 pencils. She gave 23 to her friend Ben, who asked twice before she agreed, and then 14 of her pencils snapped. Ben still has fewer pencils than Ana. Ana sold each of her remaining pencils for 6 pesos and then found 31 pesos in her desk. How many pesos does Ana have?

The gym had 56 members in January. It gained 24 members in February, 31 in March, and 41 in April. The gym, open a dozen hours a day, has 18 treadmills. Every member pays 7 dollars a week, but the gym refunded 184 dollars in a week for a broken sauna. If every week of the 4-week month brought in the same amount, how many dollars did the gym collect over the month?

A fence needs 130 feet of rails. The builder added 7 feet for a gate and 42 feet for a corner section, then removed 77 feet where a hedge stands instead. The fence will get 2 coats of paint. The supplier sells rails by the yard, and there are 3 feet in a yard. How many yards of rails does the builder order?

Priyanka shared 102 cookies equally among 3 friends, herself included, and then ate 24 of hers. The oven, which she checked twice, was set to 180 degrees. She baked 30 more cookies and then sold every cookie she had for 4 coins each. How many coins did Priyanka get?

A brewery filled 106 kegs with 5 gallons each. The bottling line works in pints, and there are 8 pints in a gallon. During bottling 660 pints were lost to spillage. Each remaining pint sold for 8 dollars. How many dollars did the brewery earn?

In the morning Tomas reviewed his project plan: 152 weeks were scheduled and 141 weeks were already complete. In the afternoon his manager cut 2 weeks from what remained, and Tomas converted the remaining time into days, at 7 days to a week. In the evening the client asked for 60 extra days of testing. His colleague Piotr has fewer days left on his own project than Tomas does. How many days remain on Tomas's project?
